package main

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"

	"github.com/daveshanley/vacuum/motor"
	"github.com/daveshanley/vacuum/rulesets"
	"github.com/pb33f/libopenapi/index"
)

type (
	finding struct {
		Rule     string
		Severity string
		Path     string
		Message  string
		Line     int
		Column   int
	}
	resourceEvidence struct {
		Role                 string
		URI                  string
		ContentSHA256        string
		IndexedContentSHA256 string
	}
	report struct {
		BinarySHA256 string
		Rules        []string
		Findings     []finding
		Resources    []resourceEvidence
		Errors       []string
	}
)

func main() {
	result := execute(os.Args[1:])
	if err := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(result); err != nil {
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	if len(result.Errors) > 0 {
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	for _, row := range result.Findings {
		if row.Severity == "error" {
			os.Exit(1)
		}
	}
}

func execute(args []string) report {
	result := report{}
	binary, err := os.Executable()
	if err != nil {
		result.Errors = append(result.Errors, err.Error())
		return result
	}
	data, err := os.ReadFile(binary)
	if err != nil {
		result.Errors = append(result.Errors, err.Error())
		return result
	}
	result.BinarySHA256 = hash(data)
	execution, resources, err := prepare(args)
	if err != nil {
		result.Errors = append(result.Errors, err.Error())
		return result
	}
	for id := range execution.RuleSet.Rules {
		result.Rules = append(result.Rules, id)
	}
	sort.Strings(result.Rules)
	outcome := motor.ApplyRulesToRuleSet(execution)
	defer outcome.Release()
	for _, err := range outcome.Errors {
		result.Errors = append(result.Errors, err.Error())
	}
	for _, row := range outcome.Results {
		item := finding{Rule: row.RuleId, Severity: row.RuleSeverity, Path: row.Path, Message: row.Message}
		if row.Rule != nil {
			item.Rule = row.Rule.Id
			item.Severity = row.Rule.Severity
		}
		if row.StartNode != nil {
			item.Line = max(0, row.StartNode.Line-1)
			item.Column = max(0, row.StartNode.Column-1)
		}
		result.Findings = append(result.Findings, item)
	}
	for _, pair := range []struct {
		role string
		root *index.SpecIndex
	}{{"resolved", execution.IndexResolved}, {"unresolved", execution.IndexUnresolved}} {
		evidence, err := resources.inspect(pair.role, pair.root)
		if err != nil {
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, err.Error())
		}
		result.Resources = append(result.Resources, evidence...)
	}
	sort.Slice(result.Findings, func(i, j int) bool {
		a, b := result.Findings[i], result.Findings[j]
		return a.Rule+a.Path+a.Message < b.Rule+b.Path+b.Message
	})
	return result
}

func hash(data []byte) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(data))
}

func prepare(args []string) (*motor.RuleSetExecution, *resourceFS, error) {
	if len(args) < 2 || len(args)%2 != 0 {
		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("expected ruleset, entry and optional URI/file pairs")
	}
	rules, err := os.ReadFile(args[0])
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	entry, err := os.ReadFile(args[1])
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	resources, err := loadResources(args[2:])
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	supplied, err := rulesets.CreateRuleSetFromData(rules)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	selected := rulesets.BuildDefaultRuleSets().GenerateRuleSetFromSuppliedRuleSet(supplied)
	if err := selected.LoadError(); err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	entryPath, err := filepath.Abs(args[1])
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	execution := &motor.RuleSetExecution{RuleSet: selected, Spec: entry, SpecFileName: entryPath, Base: filepath.Dir(entryPath), AllowLookup: true, RolodexFS: resources, SilenceLogs: true}
	return execution, resources, nil
}
